activity.notes: For the Guyana representation, ATLAS begins Burnham's Prime Minister Activity at independence on 26 May 1966 rather than including his preceding premiership of colonial British Guiana. He remained Prime Minister through the 1970 republican transition until the 1980 executive-presidency constitution.

sources.title: Guyana (12/07)
sources.citation_text: The U.S. State Department historical background states that Forbes Burnham ruled Guyana from December 1964 until August 1985, first as prime minister and, after the 1980 constitution, as executive president.

sources.title: Forbes Burnham
sources.citation_text: The standard office chronology records independent Guyana's prime-ministerial phase from 26 May 1966 to 6 October 1980 and the presidency from 6 October 1980 to 6 August 1985.
